newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Sri Lanka June '97 tea production up 33 pct.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lanka June '97 tea production up 33 pct.

text.p: Sri Lanka's tea production in June rose sharply by 33 percent to 26.41 million kg against the same period last year, the Sri Lanka Tea Board said on Monday.
It said in a statement that production in June last year was 19.86 million kg.
The statement said production in the first six months of this year was 129.92 million kg against 128.90 million in the same period last year.
Tea brokers Forbes and Walker said the June crop was a record, beating the previous high of 25.4 million in June 1983.
It said the crop in first six months of this year was also a record, beating the previous high of 129.7 million kg in the Jan-June period of 1994.
